name: @activepieces/piece-quizell
description: Quiz-based product recommendation and lead capture platform.

auth.description:
To get your Quizell API token:
1. Log in to your [Quizell](https://quizell.com) account.
2. Go to **Settings** in the left sidebar.
3. Navigate to **API & Integrations**.
4. Copy your API token from there.

Need help? See [Quizell API Docs](https://docs.quizell.com).

create_customer.name: create_customer
create_customer.description: Creates a new customer (quiz lead) in Quizell.

quiz_id.description: The ID of the quiz this customer responded to. Find it in your Quizell dashboard under the quiz settings URL (e.g. the number at the end of quizell.com/quiz/12345).

note.description: An internal note about this customer.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new customer (quiz lead) in Quizell, attached to a specific quiz. Use when capturing a new lead or contact from a quiz response. Requires a quiz_id and email; not idempotent — each call creates another customer record even with identical input.

update_customer.name: update_customer
update_customer.description: Updates an existing customer record in Quizell.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to update. Use the "List Customers" or "Get Customer" actions to find this ID.

quiz_id.description: The ID of the quiz associated with this customer.

note.description: An internal note about this customer.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Quizell customer (quiz lead), identified by customer_id. Use when correcting or enriching a known customer record; requires customer_id, quiz_id, and email. Idempotent — re-sending the same fields leaves the record in the same state.

list_customers.name: list_customers
list_customers.description: Retrieves a list of customers (quiz leads) from Quizell.

search.description: Filter customers by name or email. Leave empty to return all customers.

page.description: Page number for results. Starts at 1.

per_page.description: How many customers to return per page. Maximum is 100.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves a paginated list of Quizell customers (quiz leads); an empty search returns all customers, while a search term filters by name or email. Use to browse leads or resolve a customer by name/email when you do not have an ID. Read-only and idempotent.

get_customer.name: get_customer
get_customer.description: Retrieves details of a specific customer by their ID.

customer_id.description: The ID of the customer to retrieve. Use the "List Customers" action to find customer IDs.

aiMetadata.description: Fetches the full details of a single Quizell customer by customer_id, including custom fields. Use when you already have the customer ID (e.g. from List Customers) and need their complete record. Read-only and idempotent.

search_products.name: search_products
search_products.description: Searches for products in your Quizell catalog by title or SKU.

title.description: Search by product name. Leave empty to return all products.

sku.description: Search by product SKU (stock keeping unit). Leave empty to skip this filter.

page.description: Page number for results. Starts at 1.

per_page.description: How many products to return per page.

aiMetadata.description: Searches the Quizell product catalog with paginated results; leaving title and SKU empty returns all products, while supplying either filters the catalog, and an optional active/inactive status filter narrows further. Use to browse the catalog or resolve a product by title/SKU when you lack its ID. Read-only and idempotent.

create_product.name: create_product
create_product.description: Adds a new product to your Quizell product catalog.

title.description: The name of the product as it will appear in quiz recommendations.

price.description: The selling price of the product (e.g. 29.99).

status.description: Whether this product is active and visible in quizzes.

sku.description: Your internal stock keeping unit code for this product.

image.description: A publicly accessible URL to the product image (e.g. https://example.com/product.jpg).

vendor.description: The brand or vendor name for this product.

quantity.description: The available quantity for this product.

compare_at_price.description: The original price to show a discount (e.g. 49.99). Leave empty if there is no sale.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags to categorize this product (e.g. "skincare, moisturizer, sensitive-skin").

detail_link.description: The URL to the product page in your online store.

external_id.description: The product ID from your external system (e.g. Shopify product ID) for syncing.

aiMetadata.description: Adds a new product to the Quizell catalog so it can appear in quiz recommendations. Use when introducing a product not yet in Quizell; requires title, price, and active/inactive status. Not idempotent — each call creates another product, so guard against duplicates if syncing from an external store.

update_product.name: update_product
update_product.description: Updates an existing product in your Quizell product catalog.

product_id.description: The ID of the product to update. Use the "Search Products" action to find product IDs.

price.description: The selling price of the product (e.g. 29.99).

status.description: Whether this product is active and visible in quizzes.

sku.description: Your internal stock keeping unit code for this product.

image.description: A publicly accessible URL to the product image.

vendor.description: The brand or vendor name for this product.

quantity.description: The available quantity for this product.

compare_at_price.description: The original price to show a discount. Leave empty if there is no sale.

tags.description: Comma-separated tags to categorize this product (e.g. "skincare, moisturizer").

detail_link.description: The URL to the product page in your online store.

external_id.description: The product ID from your external system for syncing.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing Quizell catalog product, identified by product_id. Use to change price, stock, status, or other product fields on a known product; requires product_id, title, price, and status. Idempotent — re-sending the same fields leaves the product in the same state.

custom_api_call.description: Make a custom API call to a specific endpoint
